pages.title: Eat My Junk
pages.text: Race 11: Miami, 8.7 miles. Password: PALMS. About two minutes before it repeats: the longest song in the game. Skitchin' (EA, 1994), Mega Drive / Genesis. Music by Jeff van Dyck.

pages.title: Bring a friend
pages.text: Two can race in split screen, take turns, or go Head to Head, and up to eight can play a tournament. The modes are called Solo Skitch, Skitch 'n Switch, Grand Slam Jam and Double Trouble.
